evidence.detail: Recovered semantic source map identifies rs/s/p/d as rs.plugins.playeroutline.PlayerOutlinePlugin.
Startup registers the player-outline overlay and conditionally registers the pet-outline overlay from PlayerOutlineConfig.petOutline(); shutdown removes both.
The ConfigChanged subscriber toggles the pet overlay when key 'petOutline' changes.
The plugin provides PlayerOutlineConfig directly through ConfigManager.

proposals.note: Source-identified Player Outline plugin, with exact-v308 overlay lifecycle and config-change behavior.

evidence.detail: Recovered semantic source map identifies rs/s/p/a as rs.plugins.playeroutline.PlayerOutlineConfig.
Exact v308 config group is 'playeroutline' with items playerOutlineColor, petOutline, borderWidth and outlineFeather.
The exact interface defaults petOutline=true, borderWidth=4 and outlineFeather=4 and returns the configured outline color.
rs/s/p/d injects/provides this config and reacts specifically to ConfigChanged key 'petOutline'.

proposals.note: Source-identified Player Outline configuration interface, independently corroborated by exact-v308 config annotations and plugin consumption.

evidence.detail: Recovered semantic source map identifies rs/s/m/f as rs.plugins.notes.NotesPlugin.
Startup resolves the Notes panel, supplies NotesConfig, loads notes_icon.png, builds a navigation entry titled 'Notes', and adds it to the UI; shutdown removes it.
The plugin provides NotesConfig from ConfigManager and injects the same config instance used to initialize the panel.

proposals.note: Source-identified Notes plugin, independently corroborated by exact-v308 panel/navigation lifecycle.

evidence.detail: Recovered semantic source map identifies rs/s/m/a as rs.plugins.notes.NotesConfig.
Exact v308 config exposes notesData() with empty-string default plus setNotesData(String), under the Notes feature config surface.
rs/s/m/f injects/provides this config and passes it directly into the Notes panel during startup.
